args.title: Handle CRLF line endings in CSV parser
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts. parseStatement splits the uploaded text on "
" only, so files with Windows-style CRLF line endings (as produced by the new accounting export tool) leave a trailing "" on the last field of each line. For the header row this means the last column name (e.g. "description") no longer matches REQUIRED_COLUMNS, so assertShape's missingRequired check fails and throws "Malformed row" for row 1 every time. Fix by stripping a trailing "" from each line (or splitting on /
|
/) before further processing, so both Unix and Windows line endings parse correctly.
